page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is an x86_64 server instance powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 128 dedicated virtual CPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Running under the KVM hypervisor, it features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance contains no dedicated discrete GPUs and does not include bundled local disk storage.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio establishes this instance as a compute-optimized resource tailored for CPU-intensive operations. Resource density is centered on high core count execution without allocating excess memory overhead, offering cost efficiency for multi-threaded parallel processing workloads. A notable tradeoff is the absence of local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistent storage. The high network bandwidth supports intensive inter-node communication, making this instance suitable for high-performance computing, batch processing, application servers, and web serving clusters.
